Use the original producer Create logical operation already supplied by the owning caller, not physical CREATE⇒grant inference. Immutable cloud authority CREATE and SELECT only for these exact kinds; UPDATE/DELETE denied for this continuation. Consumer Read gets required source SELECT under its actual Read authorization; producer validation/readback uses its exact original producer purpose, including consent's necessary SELECT of its canonical projection. No Read→producer conversion or producer→general Read. Catalog/schema calls preserve original purpose through authenticated transaction worker/task-local bindings.

Scope cloud stable identity and idempotency by exact five tuple, kind and original immutable identity; fix corresponding indexes/ledger uniqueness consistently. A foreign canonical record hidden by permission must never masquerade as absence and authorize overwriting its ID. Compare complete immutable identity/body/canonical hashes/target/delegation/linked receipt on retry, not projection/consent hash alone. Same exact retry returns existing canonical result and no new event; same key/different body denies. Keep source keys stable and document any necessary existing scoped-record migration within the owned schema/provider; no blanket business data rewrite.

Use ONE authenticated transaction/controller and the appropriate existing admission/final-dependency checks for cloud publication plus its source validation. Remove/avoid nested BEGIN when already inside the protected transaction; direct entry must join the same controller, not run an untracked BEGIN through a data operation. Preserve pre-spawn original identity/deadline, authentication before begin, final authorization/fences and pending settlement semantics.

Allocate actual durable EventLedger identity/sequence in the authoritative database transaction and install the SAME final metadata into authority record JSON and immutable event payload before publication. Do not accept next_cloud_event_sequence wallclock/AtomicI64 as actual canonical sequence. The existing dedicated cloud ledger is the inspected receipt surface: validate/read its actual record independently by exact ID, kind/aggregate/run/five fields, payload/hash and final sequence rather than trusting copied event_payload_json. Keep its immutable SELECT/CREATE narrowly tied to original producer/consumer predicates; UPDATE/DELETE NONE. If the contract requires canonical kernel EventLedger linkage instead, use only the actual existing cloud event producer/type/stream contract discovered in source/spec and link this dedicated table as an immutable projection; do not invent event names, call the current separate ledger a kernel receipt, or open a generic kernel producer. Whichever existing authoritative receipt surface applies, canonical readback and actual assigned metadata are mandatory; stage-aware CREATE guards must avoid circular authority↔ledger existence requirements.

Reconcile get/list/replay and producer readback with actual ledger validation, current reader authorization separate from historical producer resource/capability, exact original five and canonical plan/consent links. Invalid/missing/foreign ledger, changed payload/hash, scope drift, revoked session/grant, stale plan/expired consent and wrong target/provider must deny without derivatives. Readonly validation must not append business denial receipts under Read; preserve original denial receipt semantics only under its already authorized producer purpose.

Do not open every enum kind or revoke/CAS path. Exact required fixture proves ProjectionPlan+ConsentReceipt. Inspect current original record/launch calls once: source has CloudRun/CloudLane writes at2305–2306 when actual cloud launch runs; if that ORIGINAL required path executes, bind those exact run/lane producer intents and dependencies in this SAME correction, not a later one-table loop. No blanket CloudRun/CloudLane/ConsentDenial UPDATE grant or adjacent consent-revocation rewrite. Unused kinds remain denied; required actual denial producer, if present, must use its actual original operation, never Read.

Cancellation/retry: atomic authority+receipt and canonical source validation; known rollback may release admission, unknown/pending commit retains ownership and is independently resolved by original immutable identity/receipt read. No blind retry/regenerated event identity or duplicate consent publication. Preserve controller/Atelier behavior and existing run-before-lane/CRDT admission properties.
